INCLUDE(BuildPlugin)
include_directories(SYSTEM ${FFTW3F_INCLUDE_DIRS})
LINK_LIBRARIES(${FFTW3F_LIBRARIES})

# The amp is modeled from black-box measurements of Kuassa's Amplifikation Lite (AmpLiteData.h is generated by
# export_cpp.py of that study); the artwork (*.png) is Kuassa's, used with permission.
# Its partitioned convolution is Amp & IR's.
BUILD_PLUGIN(amplifikationlite AmplifikationLite.cpp AmplifikationLiteControls.cpp AmpLiteDsp.cpp
	../AmpAndIr/Convolver.cpp
	MOCFILES AmplifikationLiteControls.h
	EMBEDDED_RESOURCES *.png)
